articles.title: 7 Greatest Betrayals in DC Comics History
articles.summary: The article delves into significant betrayals within the DC Comics universe, where heroes often betray friends, teammates, or even the entire world. While DC is commonly known for its superheroes saving the world, these plotlines introduce dramatic twists that have profoundly impacted the comic book world. Such narratives explore complex themes beyond typical hero-villain conflicts.

articles.title: Army limits social media use to 'viewing only'
articles.summary: The Indian Army has introduced updated social media rules for its personnel. Soldiers are now permitted to view and monitor platforms like Instagram; however, communication on these sites remains restricted. The new regulations also encompass messaging applications such as WhatsApp and Telegram, emphasizing the importance of online security and professional conduct for all servicemen and women.

articles.title: NFL Week 17 live game message board, fan discussion, and playoff scenarios
articles.summary: With just two weeks remaining in the 2025 NFL season, several teams in the NFC conference have successfully secured their playoff berths. Among those that have clinched spots are the Philadelphia Eagles, who are also NFC East Champions, the Seattle Seahawks, and the Chicago Bears. This sets the stage for the highly anticipated postseason in American professional football.

articles.title: Train fares hiked from December 26: Railway Ministry notifies new ticket prices, here’s how much more passengers will pay
articles.summary: The Railway Ministry officially announced a hike in passenger train fares, effective Friday, December 26. This national policy change introduces a revised ticket pricing structure, impacting commuters and the general public across the country. SSB aspirants should note such governmental decisions as they reflect economic strategies and have widespread societal implications on national infrastructure and public services.

articles.title: JCO died in firing incident cremated with full military honours in Reasi
articles.summary: An Indian Army Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) tragically died in a firing incident in Jammu and Kashmir's Samba district. He was cremated with full military honours at his native village in Reasi. This incident underscores the constant dangers and supreme sacrifices faced by our armed forces personnel while upholding national security, especially in sensitive operational areas.
